description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for plugin management commands in Mattermost, including adding, installing from URL, deleting, and listing plugins, with permission and configuration checks.

methods.name: TestPluginAddCmd
methods.description: Tests for adding plugins, including permission checks, configuration restrictions, and force option.

methods.name: TestPluginInstallURLCmd
methods.description: Tests for installing plugins from URL, handling permissions, non-existent plugins, and force reinstallation.

methods.name: TestPluginDeleteCmd
methods.description: Tests for deleting plugins, including permission checks and handling unknown plugins.

methods.name: TestPluginListCmdF
methods.description: Tests for listing plugins, including permission and configuration error handling, and JSON output.
